title: BigP3BCI Study H — 9x8 checkerboard with gaze conditions (16 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 16 healthy participants performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task. It uses a 9x8 checkerboard character grid with gaze conditions (Study H of the bigP3BCI collection). Data were recorded with 16 channels at 256 Hz and are annotated with HED tags for target and non-target events. It is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI dataset, prepared with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier using 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage at a 256 Hz sampling rate (60 Hz line frequency). Participants completed one session each of a visual P300 speller paradigm with target and non-target flashes, with online feedback in a laboratory setting.
